title: fix: filter daily usage by API key without Tinybird 400
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Qualifies the source `api_key_id` in the daily-usage pipe so ClickHouse does not resolve it to the aggregate alias.
- Fixes filtered `/account/usage/daily` JSON and CSV requests; no route or CLI changes.
- Verified the exact qualified query against production Tinybird and validated the pipe in staging (`deployment create --check`).

Deployment pending: staging already has unpromoted deployment #164, and current main also changes the unrelated `product_event` datasource. Coordinate that deployment before deploying this pipe to staging and production.

Fixes #15662

gist.headline: The right key, this time
gist.blurb: Daily usage can be filtered by API key again. Tinybird was mistaking a source column for its aggregate alias; the pipe now tells them apart.
gist.summary: Qualified the source `api_key_id` in the daily-usage Tinybird pipe, preventing an aggregate-alias collision that returned HTTP 400 for API-key-filtered `/account/usage/daily` requests.
gist.impact: Users can get daily usage for a specific API key in JSON or CSV without changing their requests.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy usage dashboard where Polli helps the monitor robot connect a labeled API key to the correct source column, revealing a tidy daily chart. A small code-plant and lime-green screen glow keep the database fix grounded in the garden.
